verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is published as an open-source project on GitHub. The vendor docs explicitly distinguish 'TruffleHog Open Source' from Enterprise, and community reports confirm v3 is AGPL-licensed (previously GPL) and that users read the codebase directly. missing for 10: first-party statement of the license terms, clarity that Enterprise-only features (e.g. SSO, RBAC) are not covered by the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Note that v3 shifts to AGPL, from GPL in prior versions.
Compare TruffleHog Open Source and TruffleHog Enterprise.
